description: This PHP source file defines the LeaveReportDataAPI class, which extends a base report data API. It provides an API endpoint for retrieving leave report data with detailed OpenAPI annotations for documentation. The class's primary functionality is encapsulated in the getReport() method that validates report types and returns corresponding report objects.

classes.name: LeaveReportDataAPI
classes.description: API class for fetching leave report data; handles report validation and instantiation based on report name.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Validates the report name and returns an instance of the corresponding report class. Throws BadRequestException if the report name is invalid.
